status_summary: No HUD-specific order reassigning delegated authority or converting named HUD career leadership posts was found. Government-wide, Executive Order 14171 (signed 2025-01-20, published 2025-01-31) directed creation of a Schedule Policy/Career category, and OPM's final rule (published 2026-02-06, effective 2026-03-09) lets policy-influencing positions be placed in it while remaining career and merit-filled. Executive Order 14410 (signed 2026-06-03, published 2026-06-10) placed the positions listed in its appendix in Schedule Policy/Career; the appendix is published only as page images and whether HUD positions are included was not confirmed. HUD announced a chief of staff and two deputy chiefs of staff on 2025-06-27 without stating their appointment type.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14171 on policy-influencing positions was published in the Federal Register.
HUD announced a chief of staff and two deputy chiefs of staff.
OPM's final Schedule Policy/Career rule was published (91 FR 5580), effective 2026-03-09.
Executive Order 14410, signed 2026-06-03, was published, placing the positions listed in its appendix in Schedule Policy/Career.

title: Shift HUD delegated authority and leadership posts to political appointees
uncertainties: HUD delegation orders are internal and were not found publicly. The appendix of Executive Order 14410 is image-only on federalregister.gov, govinfo.gov and whitehouse.gov, so HUD coverage is unconfirmed; one targeted web search found no reporting on HUD positions. Schedule Policy/Career keeps positions career rather than converting them to political posts, so the match is partial. The OPM release carries no printed date.
